desc:
⛵ Welcome to Build a Boat!

How to Play:
🧱 Pick up blocks and carry them to the boat.
🤝 Work together with everyone in the server.
🌊 Board before the flood and survive the storm!
⚡ Train to increase your speed and strength.
🥚 Hatch pets to boost your power.
🏆 Complete boats to become even stronger!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
